mechanism.claim: At a fixed four-hour boundary in an unusually volatile completed BTC block, a close materially displaced from that block's base-volume VWAP represents a short-lived inventory-location imbalance. Fade the close back toward the traded center for two elapsed hours.
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCVR chooses direction from the completed block's traded-volume center. FHVAR chose continuation from agreeing two-hour return signs and variance acceleration; its direction-fade control cannot be promoted and is not reused. Prior daily tail fades did not use block VWAP.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: six fixed UTC block-VWAP clocks and volume-location geometry are absent from Gross9

features.block_valid: 240 exact distinct minute rows in [decision-4h,decision), finite positive coherent OHLC, finite nonnegative base and quote volume, positive summed base volume; no imputation
features.realized_variation: sum squared 1m close-to-close log returns within the block
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank among at most 180 valid fixed four-hour blocks, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi_premium_implied_vol: not signal inputs; exact funding only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, VWAP, or subset repair.
